Container.Name: PlexBridge
Container.Overview:
PlexBridge is a self-hosted Blazor app that syncs watch history, ratings and playlists between two Plex servers. What you have watched, how you rated it, and the playlists you keep on one server can be brought across to the other.
The web interface is on the port below. Everything PlexBridge stores is kept in the appdata folder, mounted at /config in the container.
The Lyrics page can save a timed .lrc or a plain .txt next to a music track after you confirm. For that, point Libraries below at the folder that contains all your Plex media libraries. It is mounted read-write at /libraries. Features that write next to media use it (lyrics now). On Library paths, PlexBridge maps each library folder Plex reports. Existing lyrics files are not replaced. Plex has to be able to read the new files, which is the usual case when both containers use PUID 99 and PGID 100. Not affiliated with Plex.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex sync watch history ratings playlists watched status two servers lyrics lrc plexamp

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the PlexBridge web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings and data. Mounted at /config in the container.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Point this at the folder that contains all your Plex media libraries. Mounted read-write at /libraries. Features that write next to media use it (lyrics now). Leave this blank if you are not writing next to media. Plex has to be able to read the new files. That is the usual case when both containers use PUID 99 and PGID 100. This container does not change ownership of the share.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID PlexBridge runs as. It owns the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for dates shown in the interface, for example America/Chicago.
